blocks.text: Wise Women is a circle of women involved in culture and the creative arts, founded with the aim of bringing people together and fostering collaboration, sharing best practice, celebrating the richness and diversity of women’s life journeys, and engaging in knowledge-sharing and mentoring initiatives.

Launched in 2017, the group was formally established as a registered charity in 2019 and, in 2020, launched its call for proposals – a key initiative designed to highlight and support professional artistic and creative projects.
​The creative sectors represented within the association are wide-ranging: contemporary art, fashion, design, photography, film, music, culinary arts, publishing, media and artistic direction.
​Women join the circle by co-optation; members from across generations with complementary profiles come together in a spirit of sharing and sisterhood.

The winning projects will benefit from a bespoke programme structured around professional development workshops and five meetings with active and influential professionals, selected for their expertise and inspiring careers in the creative industries. The programme aims to accelerate the candidates’ projects by broadening their skills and networks. It is divided into two stages:

An acceleration day The day’s programme includes: group and individual coaching, a masterclass on issues common to all projects (structuring, funding, etc.), portfolio reviews, co-development, and more. By the end of the day, the winners will have gained numerous insights to help accelerate their projects, thanks to the expertise and support of the experts involved.

The formation of a support network around each winning project. Based on the specific needs identified, matching with five expert mentors identification of areas where extra support is needed (making contacts, reviewing applications, etc.), which are then shared with the entire Wise Women community​
